_readme: Exposure decisions for the tool parity audit (scripts/tool-parity.mjs). Every tool visible on either surface (MCP bridge / playground agent) must be recorded here as 'gap' (absence is a defect to fix) or 'deliberate' (absence is design, with the reason). Unannotated tools fail `bun run tool:parity --check`. Seeded from docs/design/TOOL-SYSTEM.md's exposure matrix.

pyric_can_i_use.reason: Shared MCP and Playground trust query; the CLI/MCP retain full claims while the browser receives only the measured compact projection

build_game_rules.reason: Playground skill-specific authoring workflow, activated only by its skill; not a general MCP primitive

debug_firestore_rules.reason: Playground orchestration wrapper; external agents compose the MCP rules and inspection primitives directly

firestore_add_document.reason: attached-sandbox CRUD belongs in MCP; the Playground uses its native session workspace instead of duplicating the bridge data plane

firestore_delete_document.reason: attached-sandbox CRUD belongs in MCP; the Playground uses its native session workspace instead of duplicating the bridge data plane

firestore_extract_indexes.reason: artifact generation is exposed through `pyric firestore indexes generate`; external agents can invoke the CLI without a duplicate MCP tool
